title: 泰国道教总会祝贺视频
body: 泰国道教总会制作祝贺视频，以视频形式表达对协会成立的热烈祝贺与美好祝愿。
body_en: The Thailand Taoist Federation produced a congratulatory video, expressing warm congratulations and best wishes for the association's establishment through video format.
